frame_row: Structural top of the asynchronous APB bridge. It joins the requester-side block and the completer-side block and holds no logic of its own. One APB transfer crosses the clock boundary as a request bundle and a response bundle; only the request and acknowledge control bits pass through synchronizers.

label: u_vlsit_apbcdc_mst
(m_vlsit_apbcdc_mst)
blocks.function: APB completer of the requester side, in the requester clock domain. It captures the Setup phase of a transfer into a hold register, launches the request control bit (a toggle in the two-phase handshake, a level in the four-phase handshake), keeps the response-ready output low until the answer is available, then loads the response bundle and raises the ready output for one cycle. It receives the acknowledge control bit through a synchronizer and passes the optional wake-up indication on to the other side.

label: u_vlsit_apbcdc_slv
(m_vlsit_apbcdc_slv)
blocks.function: APB requester of the completer side, in the completer clock domain. It receives the request control bit and the wake-up indication through synchronizers, loads the request bundle into a payload register, drives one APB transfer to the external completer, captures the response into a hold register, and launches the acknowledge control bit. The request and response bundles are stable for the whole handshake, so they cross as timed paths without synchronizers.

legend_note: The enclosing frame is the top module; blocks inside are its instances. The two clocks are asynchronous. Only the control bits pass through synchronizers inside the two blocks; the bundles are timed paths.
